name: v0.3.32 one button after an alternate payload
research_question: After an alternate payload is chosen, does one untried button click on the next returning decision of a non-hub page keep Guard bugs and confirm the empty-title submit bug?
diagnosis: On marsh, cove, glen, and forge at budget 120, step 18 typed the empty title as alternate_payload and step 19 returned. The submit button was never clicked. Guard confirmed the empty-title bug by typing the empty title and then clicking submit. Historical Guard loss was empty. The v0.3.31 module is not edited. The rule does not take a link, a return, or any click on a hub.
not: an edit of the frozen v0.3.31 candidate
permission to take an arbitrary untried click
permission to click on a hub
permission to change the product default
permission to retune after the fresh matrix

candidate.rule: Arm a one-shot when an alternate payload is chosen. On the next returning decision of that same branch, if the page is not a hub, take the first untried button click. Do not take a link or a return action. If the page is a hub or the branch changed, drop the one-shot.

topology_rule: New positives keep the chart-to-prefs page. Submit, probe, and export stay on that prefs page. The score page stays on the roster hub.

outcomes.C: Guard loss on a fresh target, historical Guard loss, safety violation, negative handoff, candidate edit, or product-default change
outcomes.D: Safety holds but fewer than 3 positives are evaluable
outcomes.B: Guard bugs are kept and at least 3 positives are evaluable, but fewer than 3 keep every Guard bug, confirm the empty-title submit bug, and record a payload-button selection
outcomes.A: At least 3 positives keep every Guard bug, confirm the empty-title submit bug, and record a payload-button selection. Negatives have no nested handoff. The historical suite loses no Guard bug. The product default stays unchanged.
